items.text: Emeka Egbuka ruled OUT (concussion/foot) for Week 8 vs Falcons; second straight miss. Projections updated for fallout.
items.why: Final injury report and Schefter confirmation.
items.implication: Bucs WR depth thins; look to other TB pass-catchers or Falcons matchup plays.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining Bucs WRs.

items.text: Carnell Tate OUT (shoulder) Week 8; no practice this week.
items.why: Final report; Schefter listed among outs.
items.opportunity: More volume for remaining Titans receivers.

items.text: RJ Harvey OUT (knee) vs Chiefs; unique role means no clean replacement but 3-6 extra targets available. Waddle also Q (chest).
items.why: Broncos final report; Levitan notes unique role.
items.implication: DEN backfield/ target share shifts; Waddle status key.
items.opportunity: 3-6 more targets in DEN offense; monitor Waddle.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT; Barkley has no designation and is IN/expected to play.
items.why: Eagles report; Schefter confirms Smith out, Barkley clear.
items.implication: PHI WRs thin; Barkley full go despite prior hamstring/back.
items.opportunity: More work for remaining PHI pass-catchers; Barkley snaps/carries secure.

items.text: Lamar Jackson IN/no designation (ankle); expected to play vs Bills after missing three games. Small docks on rushing possible.
items.why: Ravens report; Schefter/Rapoport confirm no designation and expected.
items.implication: Major upgrade for Ravens offense and Flowers.
items.opportunity: Full Lamar unlocks Flowers/Henry usage; track meet potential vs BUF.

items.text: Colts now open to trading Jonathan Taylor; talks active/ongoing with multiple teams.
items.implication: Deadline watch; value/ROS uncertainty if moved.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad) again; was close last week, now cryptic tweets + Q tag. Trade rumors circulating.
items.why: Final report; Levitan notes uncertainty and rumors.
items.implication: Game-time; monitor for Allen handcuff upside.
items.opportunity: If out, Braelon Allen full workload.

items.text: Rashee Rice and Jeremiyah Love IN/expected; Love off report after ankle, Rice no designation.
items.why: Final reports; Schefter confirms Rice expected.
items.implication: Full go for both; Love startable vs DAL.
items.opportunity: Rice targets back; Love carries/snaps secure.

items.text: AJ Brown QUESTIONABLE (knee/ankle); Levitan/ETR took him OUT in projs as of Friday. Game-time.
items.implication: NE WR1 if out goes to Douglas/others.
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevated role for NE depth WRs.

items.text: Josh Jacobs going Ashton Jeanty route: strong fantasy value via high-value touches. 3 inside-5 carries + 13 targets in two games post-suspension. Efficiency bonus if it comes.
items.why: Inside-5 and target volume driving value despite efficiency.
items.implication: Start with confidence vs CAR; parallel to Jeanty.

items.text: Zay Flowers LOVE/WR5 @ BUF; Lamar unlock + track-meet game vs Bills.
items.why: Lamar return + high-scoring environment; quarterback-proof volume.

items.text: Derrick Henry LOVE/RB6 @ BUF; Chase Brown LOVE/RB8 vs TEN; Josh Jacobs LOVE/RB11 vs CAR. Soft run defenses.
items.why: Matchups vs run-weak defenses; Henry history, Brown TD regression, Jacobs volume.

items.text: After two-TD outing, sell Quinshon Judkins high; role hit with Sampson return (season-low snaps/targets).
items.why: Snap/target share drop with teammate back; Berry 10 Facts corroborates role hit.
items.opportunity: Majority touches remain but targets down.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle HATE (production + Chiefs tough on WRs); Saquon Barkley HATE/RB20 (usage concerns despite clear); also Pollard/Hampton hates.
items.why: Tough matchups/usage questions; Waddle chest Q compounds.
items.conflict: Barkley IN/clear per ETR/Schefter but usage still concern.
